description: Technical mechanisms for detecting security incidents are not deployed or configured. This signal indicates that attacks, breaches, or unauthorized activities may occur without being identified in a timely manner.
applicability: Applicable to security monitoring infrastructure including SIEM systems, intrusion detection, endpoint detection, and alerting mechanisms. Includes both automated detection and manual review capabilities.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through review of monitoring infrastructure, alerting configurations, detection rule coverage, and incident detection testing.

sources.title: 32 CFR Part 170 - Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification Program
